name: Alassio (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of purple and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alassio (a figure on a tower, counterchanged) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI ALASSIO in white arched above.
history: Flag flown at the town hall and town entrances of Alassio, a comune in Liguria; the Italian Wikipedia notes it differs from the official blazon, being a bicolour charged with the arms and the inscription COMUNE DI ALASSIO. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 15 July 1983.
